factProposals.value: A readiness assessment against the July 1, 2027 go-live date: automatic checks of the system plus items people confirm, a verdict of ready or not ready, and every blocker named.
A project manager role assesses readiness and records the items only people can confirm; system administrators can too.

Whether user acceptance testing, staff training, data conversion rehearsal, the cut-over plan, the city's roles, retention rules, production backups and vendor API testing are done is recorded by people; the system never decides them.
Each readiness assessment is kept permanently with the reviewer's user id and email, start and finish times, days to go-live, every item's result and the verdict, and is audited.
Launch readiness depends on work outside the build: real GIS and Blue Stakes access, Lama and Sprypoint integrations (vendor coordination), user acceptance testing and data conversion.
Which system holds the existing work order data, and how much of it must be converted, is not known.

decisions.statement: Check automatically what the system can verify about itself, and have people confirm the rest.
decisions.rationale: Testing sign-off, training and data conversion are judgements the system cannot make; configuration and connections it can verify.

decisions.statement: Count a connection as live only with recent evidence of a successful call or data exchange.
decisions.rationale: A setting saying live is not proof that the real service works.

decisions.statement: Run the create, update and complete smoke test on a throwaway database with the same code.
decisions.rationale: It checks the REQ-051 guardrail on every assessment without adding test work orders to real data.

decisions.statement: Give the ready verdict only if every item passes, count a check that crashes as failed, and give no result if the assessment cannot be recorded.
decisions.rationale: An assessment must never pass something it could not check, and every assessment must be on record with its reviewer.

limitations.statement: Today's system is not ready: GIS and Blue Stakes run on stand-ins, Lama and Sprypoint are not integrated, and none of the people-confirmed items are done. Ready has only been shown with a fully prepared example.
Whether GIS and Blue Stakes are live is declared when the server starts and then checked against the logs; there is no separate health check call to those services.
There is no readiness page; the checklist and assessments are used through the API.
